data.text:
Sanjay Kumar Singh vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 1 April, 
2024 
Author: Salil Kumar Rai
Bench: Salil Kumar Rai
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:54958
Court No. - 37
Case :- Writ - A No. - 4183 of 2024
Petitioner :- Sanjay Kumar Singh
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Chhaya Gupta,Sujeet Kumar 
Counsel for Respondent :- Ashutosh Mishra,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Heard the counsel for the petitioner and Shri Ashutosh Mishra, counsel for the respondent no. 2. 
The present petition has been filed challenging the order dated 21.02.2024 passed by the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Uttar Pradesh, at Lucknow transferring the petitioner from Prayagraj to Etawah. The petitioner claims to be a specially abled person with 50 %
permanent disability in his right leg making the petitioner a case of Locomotor Disability. 
It has been argued that in view of Clause 5.5 of the Government policy dated 07.06.2023, the petitioner is entitled to be retained at Prayagarj and not to be transferred at any other place except Sanjay Kumar Singh vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 1 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101505109/
1 when there are any serious complaints against the petitioner or for any other unavoidable reasons.
In pursuance to the previous order passed by this Court, the Standing Counsel has obtained instructions and handed over a copy of the same to the Court which is taken on record.
A perusal of the instructions of the Standing Counsel do not state that there are any serious complaints against the petitioner or the petitioner cannot be retained at District Prayagraj due to any unavoidable reason. Apparently, the order dated 21.02.2024 passed by the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Uttar Pradesh, at Lucknow is contrary to the policy of the Government itself and is also arbitrary. The order has been passed without any application of mind. 
The order dated 21.02.2024 is, hereby quashed. 
The petition is allowed. 
Order Date :- 1.4.2024 Vipasha  Sanjay Kumar Singh vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 1 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101505109/
